Report target runtime provenance and HWH identity. Any missing evidence, mismatch, exception or unverified cleanup is failed/nonzero. test_steps: Only A/root current Desktop board owner: review this exact PR9 head and new manifest; verify every artifact against source commit 9b618204473c8fda1bffbaf436080d77a34db5fc using raw Git blobs, not Windows git archive or converted checkout bytes. Serialize base overlay/iop_pmoda BRAM ownership. This is the v3 metadata fix; preserve the v2 failed result and never replay its old request.

Use the authorized root login-shell environment BOARD=Pynq-Z2, XILINX_XRT=/usr, cwd=/tmp and /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/bin/python3. Verify transferred script SHA256 b0b6eef6064812deb34639306143972e740ed1e4dc38bfeb979ff31cdfd90eda. No credential handling in the script.

Run once: /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/bin/python3 /tmp/base_bram_board_test.py --bitstream /usr/local/share/pynq-venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/pynq/overlays/base/base.bit --output /tmp/base-bram-v3-metadata-r1-result.json --operation-id BOARD-20261013-A:B:base-bram-v3-metadata-r1 --request-hash <this manifest request_hash> --code-commit 9b618204473c8fda1bffbaf436080d77a34db5fc --tested-commit <exact final PR9 head SHA>. Output must not exist. Preserve command, stdout, stderr, exit code and timeout status; do not automatically retry.

Before loading once, the script verifies bit SHA256 ecabdcb5d483c75335ab6f043824a2386971c7b0ffd6e3315f24860bf5088eb6 and HWH SHA256 cbd90c84f3a46d1eba95dff7ba7d0079812f7e46641a08e2318c9928cd36ce8f. HWH must identify exactly one /iop_pmoda/mb_bram_ctrl AXI BRAM xilinx.com:ip:axi_bram_ctrl:4.1, with C_S_AXI_BASEADDR 0x40000000 and HIGHADDR 0x4000FFFF, and exactly one matching PS GP0/S_AXI MEMORY/Mem0 mapping via module INSTANCE. Record pre/post PL identity; do not claim prior-overlay restoration.

Cross-check runtime ip_dict and/or mem_dict against that HWH before reset/MMIO. DDR4 in mem_dict is only a synthetic label. Every present phys_addr/addr_range and base_address/size pair must be complete and agree at 0x40000000/65536; missing, conflicting or wrong mappings must fail closed. Validate the reset GPIO metadata index 0 and its two target pins, then derive the Linux GPIO with GPIO.get_gpio_pin. This compatibility was replayed locally against A evidence commit b395767272909229dd3acb289bd71a82ab8c4211.

If the dynamically resolved reset GPIO is unexported, export only that GPIO and record observed direction/value with post_load_post_export_sysfs_observation and pre_export_output_latch_known=false. Existing exports use post_load_existing_export_sysfs_observation. Set direction=high and verify fresh sysfs value/direction. Do not construct GPIO(out), infer null as zero, or claim knowledge of the invisible pre-export output latch.

While reset remains high, snapshot 16 uint32 words at offsets 0xFC00..0xFC3C. For each of 3 rounds, write all 16 before reading all 16 for each batch: zero, FFFFFFFF, 55555555, AAAAAAAA, A5A50000|index, its uint32 inverse, 1<<index, and 16 getrandbits(32) values from Random(0x20261013) generated once and reused each round. Record 384 expected/observed values and physical MMIO sources.

Finally keep reset high, attempt all 16 original-word restore writes and all 16 readback checks. Only after successful full restoration restore the observed reset value/direction and verify them, then unexport only if this run exported it. Failed restoration yields nonzero exit, reset_restore_withheld=true and attempted reset-high retention; preserve snapshots/errors for A recovery. Never reload the overlay or rerun automatically.

A reports the same operation_id/request_hash/code_commit/tested_commit, actual runtime, command, exit/timeout, JSON/stdout/stderr paths and SHA256 on PR9 and the evidence PR. Board clock and A host clock remain separately recorded. A alone determines measured hardware acceptance.
